Our Services

Paintless dent repair in Bellingham, Washington, for suitable door dings, creases, hail dents, and minor impacts. When the damage is a good fit, the original paint stays in place.

01
Service 01

Door Ding Repair

A parking-lot ding can catch the light even when the paint is intact. We look at where it landed, whether the panel can be reached, and how much the metal has stretched before recommending paintless repair.

  • Small dents from adjacent doors or shopping carts
  • A good option when the original paint is intact
  • Assessments for doors and other reachable panels
  • No sanding, filler, or repainting when PDR is a fit
Ask About a Door Ding
02
Service 02

Dents & Creases

Creases need a closer look, especially where they run along a sharp body line. The depth of the crease, the condition of the finish, and access to the panel all help determine whether paintless repair is practical.

  • Shallow creases and dents on suitable panels
  • Careful assessment around body lines and edges
  • Factory finish preserved where the panel can be reshaped
  • A clear explanation if another repair is a better fit
Get a Crease Assessment
03
Service 03

Hail Damage Repair

Hail often leaves a pattern of shallow dents across the hood, roof, or trunk. Send a wide photo of the panel and a few close-ups so we can see how far the damage extends and whether the paint is intact.

  • Assessment of the hood, roof, and trunk
  • Coverage and severity considered panel by panel
  • An in-person look when photos don’t show the damage clearly
  • Paintless repair for suitable dents
Ask About Hail Damage
04
Service 04

Minor Impact Dents

A light bump can leave a visible dent without breaking the paint. We’ll consider the shape of the damage and the condition of the panel. If it needs collision or paint work, we’ll say so.

  • Light contact dents on suitable metal panels
  • Inspection of the original paint and access to the dent
  • Practical guidance when the damage needs a body shop
  • No promise of paintless repair before assessment
Show Us the Damage
05
Service 05

Free Dent Assessment

Not sure what kind of dent you have? Start with a close-up, a photo from an angle, and a wider view of the panel. We’ll explain what the photos show and whether we need to see the vehicle in person.

  • Photo-based first look at the affected panel
  • Help identifying the damage and possible next steps
  • An honest recommendation based on your vehicle
  • Free estimates for Bellingham drivers
Get a Free Estimate
